title: Plakar OpenStack Instance Exporter Connector Config

location.$comment: ^ start, openstack-instance:// literal, then nothing/"spawn" (new server) or a server ID (attach every disk to that existing server), $ end
location.description: openstack-instance:// or openstack-instance://spawn to spawn a new server, or openstack-instance://<server-id> to attach every restored disk to that existing server

openstack_region.$comment: ^ start, [^,]* no comma, [^,\s] one character that is neither a comma nor a space, [^,]* no comma, $ end
openstack_region.description: Region to restore the server in

openstack_upload_mode.description: direct uploads each disk to Glance in one unparallelized PUT; staged splits it into parallel Swift segments first, which needs object storage in the target region's catalog

openstack_application_credential_id.description: Application credential ID; takes precedence over password authentication

openstack_project_id.description: Project ID, for password authentication; this or openstack_project_name is required

openstack_project_name.description: Project name, for password authentication; ignored if openstack_project_id is set

openstack_domain_name.description: Domain of the user, and of the project when given by name, for password authentication

allOf.$comment: An application credential needs both its ID and its secret.
Authenticate with an application credential, or with a username and password.
Password authentication must name the project to scope the token to.
